news.name: the new film Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
news.facts:
- Title: "Ramayana: Rise of a Legend" (Part 1). Director Nitesh Tiwari; producer Namit Malhotra; made by Prime Focus Studios with DNEG and Yash's Monster Mind Creations. [verified]
- Worldwide release Thursday 5 November 2026; paid previews 4 November in India and North America (some outlets wrongly say 6 Nov). Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, plus an English version. 3D, IMAX 3D and 4DX. Sony Pictures distributes outside India. [verified]
- Cast: Ranbir Kapoor (Rama), Yash (Ravana), Sai Pallavi (Sita), Sunny Deol (Hanuman), Ravie Dubey (Lakshmana); Anupam Kher voices Jatayu, a CGI character. [verified]
- Music: Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman - their first collaboration and Zimmer's first Indian film (official). [verified]
- Budget: Namit Malhotra said both parts together cost about $500 million (about Rs 4,000 crore), self-funded; outlets call it India's costliest film; that is roughly 8x RRR's reported ~Rs 500 crore. The figure is for BOTH parts, not Part 1. [verified quote; comparison reported]
- Cinematographer Pankaj Kumar: every shot was pre-visualised with motion-capture technology; the sets were mostly digital environments with partial set pieces and blue screen. [reported, Variety India]
- Action by Terry Notary (Avatar, Planet of the Apes) and Guy Norris (Mad Max: Fury Road); VFX by DNEG and ReDefine; "shot for IMAX" (Prime Focus); TheWrap reports it is the first Indian production with the "Filmed for IMAX" label. [official / reported]
- AI: Nitesh Tiwari said no AI was used for the dubbed voices (real artists dubbed); AI (Brahma AI) is used only to match lip movements in the dubbed versions. [verified]
- Malhotra says over 10,000 people worked on the film worldwide. [reported]
- Part 2 is officially planned for Diwali 2027. Diwali this year is Sunday 8 November. [verified]
